options.systemMessage:
<task>
Act as a precise Workload Analysis Unit. Your only goal is to determine if the primary daily and weekly responsibilities of the provided Job Description meet specific AI-centric thresholds.
</task>

<rules>
- Respond ONLY using the provided JSON output tool.
- Answer every question with exactly "Yes" or "No".
- Use semantic understanding: Analyze the *verbs* and *objectives* to estimate time allocation.
- is_ai_orchestration_heavy: Answer "Yes" ONLY if designing, building, managing, or debugging autonomous workflows, data-backbones for agents, or real-time context retrieval systems (n8n, Supabase, API-chaining, LLM orchestration) appears to constitute at least 50% of the weekly workload.
- is_ai_mentoring_heavy: Answer "Yes" ONLY if coaching teams (internal or external) on AI adoption, prompting techniques, and operational change management constitutes at least 50% of the workload.
- is_ai_strategy_heavy: Answer "Yes" ONLY if discovery phases, identifying AI opportunities, building business cases, and translating stakeholder intent into technical roadmaps constitutes at least 50% of the workload.
  - CRITICAL: Answer "No" if the years refer to the company's age, the team's combined experience, or the age of a technology.
  - CRITICAL: Answer "No" if the requirement is 3 years or fewer.
- CRITICAL: If a responsibility is not explicitly mentioned or the time allocation feels secondary/occasional, you MUST output "No".
- Do not use outside knowledge or research.
- Do not factor in "Autonomy," "Salary," or "Perks" in this unit. Focus ONLY on the percentage of technical/strategic work.
</rules>

json.job_description:
I am looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to take ownership of production LLM systems, including chatbot backend, RAG pipelines, and Azure OpenAI integrations. You will also maintain a Scala/Akka legacy system, support a high-volume transcription service, and contribute to an AI orchestration layer. The role requires strong Python backend skills, Scala experience, and hands-on work with LLMs and production ML systems. You will work in a small cross-functional team with full end-to-end ownership of customer-facing services.

🚀 Project

maintain and develop the LLM chatbot backend, including RAG pipelines and Azure OpenAI integrations
own the Scala/Akka legacy chatbot, troubleshoot issues and support production operations
ensure reliability and continued development of a transcription service processing over a million events per week
contribute to the development of an AI orchestration layer routing requests across different models
take end-to-end ownership of production systems used by paying customers
collaborate with product, design and QA in a small cross-functional team

🎯 Skills

strong Python backend development, ideally with FastAPI or similar async frameworks
solid Scala proficiency with ability to read, maintain and troubleshoot existing codebases
experience with Apache Pekko or Akka actor framework
hands-on experience with LLM integrations, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering
experience working with self-hosted ML models in production
experience operating and owning production systems independently
security-conscious approach to software development
ability to proactively seek out information and solve problems independently
